description: Finish an Alexa sign-in started by alexa_begin_login. Pass the loginId and the full address of the www.amazon.com/ap/maplanding page the user landed on (or just its authorization code). Registers this server as an "alexa-mcp" device on the Amazon account, saves the session, and checks it by reading the device list. Each sign-in link can be finished once; if it fails, start again with alexa_begin_login.

redirectUrl.description: The full address of the www.amazon.com/ap/maplanding page after signing in (or its authorization code).

name: alexa_finish_login
